name: Terminal bell on permission prompt
oneLine: Rings the terminal bell when Claude asks for permission. Zero dependencies.
description: The simplest hook in the library: a one-line command that prints the BEL character on permission prompts. No script file, no jq, nothing to install. Your terminal emulator turns it into a sound or a badge bounce.
installSteps: Add the config fragment to ~/.claude/settings.json. That is the whole install.
testSteps: Positive: trigger a permission prompt - the terminal bell rings (check your emulator's bell settings if silent).
Negative: regular output should not ring.
verifiedAgainst: Claude Code hooks reference, event/matcher schema checked 2026-09-10
seoTitle: Terminal bell on permission prompt - Claude Code hook
seoDescription: Zero-dependency hook that rings the terminal bell on permission prompts.
